inference_substrate_note: Pure re-analysis of banked evidence. No GPU, no model load, no live or scored ARC game, no submission. Reads upstream JSON and computes exact tests.
verifier_is_oracle_note: No verifier-value or moat claim is made. This artifact measures whether an induce-side intervention can be decided at any endpoint; it makes no claim that a learned verifier adds value.
question: Is there an endpoint closer to the repeat_penalty induce intervention than banked levels that is both RESPONSIVE to the intervention and PREDICTIVE of banked levels, and if so what n decides it?
headline: No. Every stage that responds is either already saturated in the live pipeline or UNDECIDABLE as a predictor at n=12; every stage that predicts does so only post-bank. The 12-game/2-banker corpus cannot localize the break at all: only predictor group sizes {2,3,9,10} can reach p<0.05, and the only such predictors are the reverse-causal post-bank stages.

engine_scored_any.note: zero variance in the live population -> cannot carry anything

b_design_limit.interpretation: With 12 games and 2 bankers, only a predictor positive in 2, 3, 9 or 10 games can attain p<0.05. Any stage true of 4-8 games is UNDECIDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, so "responds but does not predict" is not an empirical result for those stages. This supersedes the first pass, which read those rows as nulls.

b_missing_data.why_it_matters: vc33 is the top-banking game (2 levels) and carries no change_gate block, so the correctness (b) test silently excluded the best performer. Imputed BOTH ways the test remains undecidable (floors 0.0909 and 0.1515).

endpoint_movability._why: A positive control for an endpoint is not "the counter is sometimes nonzero" but "some manipulation MOVES it". Three independent manipulations are on disk.
endpoint_movability.conclusion: Three independent manipulations moved banked levels exactly zero times. The endpoint has no demonstrated dynamic range in this corpus, so every per-stage "does not predict" verdict is untestable rather than tested.

branch1_force_admit_refutation_corrected.first_pass_claim: action traces byte-identical in 10 of 10 matched pairs
branch1_force_admit_refutation_corrected.why_that_was_weak: All 10 matched pairs have plan_length=0 in the admit arm, so byte-identical traces are MECHANICALLY ENTAILED, not independent evidence. Trace-identity was measured only where force-admit did nothing. All 10 sit on the five games whose engine arm provably changes nothing; vc33, the only game with dynamic range, has ZERO admit cells.
branch1_force_admit_refutation_corrected.stronger_honest_form: Where force-admit produced and executed REAL plans (lengths 61 and 6, on tn36) the action trace DID change and levels_gained was still 0. Levels gained across all 27 admit cells: [0].
branch1_force_admit_refutation_corrected.scope_limit: Force-admit was never applied to vc33. Branch 1 is therefore NOT refuted in general -- it is inert on five games that bank nothing under any condition.

branch2_correctness_game_level.note: The first pass classified games from the PAIRED corpus and read the endpoint from the LIVE grid -- a cross-population inference. Both classifications are reported; they disagree, and both observed p values sit at their floor.
branch2_correctness_game_level.withdrawn_claim: "certainly not positive" is WITHDRAWN -- at these floors nothing about direction is established.

bottleneck_attribution.corroboration: the LLM-on/off artifact records 8 of 10 dynamics-gate survivors then killed by the goal gate, and goal_predicate_satisfiable false in 6 of 7 induction events on its primary on arm
bottleneck_attribution.attribution_NOT_decided: The upstream artifact states verbatim: "This experiment does NOT decide it. Both readings are consistent." Reading A (14 of 29 scored rounds at held-out accuracy exactly 0.0) is equally consistent: pre-bank goal predicates may be degenerate BECAUSE the engines feeding them are wrong -- still generator-limited. This artifact carries that non-attribution forward rather than resolving it.

engine_corpus_filtering.correction: An earlier draft compared 97.9% clean against "36.1% defect-carrying". 36.1% is the control arm USABLE rate (13/36), a different quantity. The control clean rate is 14/36 = 38.9%; its defect-carrying rate is 61.1%.

cost_channel_robustness.why: The Poisson rate-ratio is UNPAIRED and assumes independent events, but the attempts are seed-paired and clustered in 6 games (usable-count var/mean 1.18 control, 1.38 treatment -> overdispersed, so that p is anti-conservative).
cost_channel_robustness.verdict: usable/GPU-hour survives all three tests (Poisson, paired sign, cluster bootstrap). strict-quality/GPU-hour does not survive any of them.

required_n_model: Replicated exactly from the Phase-3 refusal (commit c39f4bde6): per-cell P(one-way discordant) = majority-direction discordant count / 36; significance needs >=6 one-way discordant pairs; "cells" = smallest n with P(Binom(n,p)>=6) >= 0.50. Reproduces the refusal's published 68 (channel A) and 16 (channel B) exactly.
required_n_determinism_caveat: The banked-levels column inherits the refusal's assumption that levels are a deterministic function of the stage. The project's own evidence contradicts it in BOTH directions: vc33 banks 2 levels with zero pre-bank inductions (endpoint moved, stage did not), and force-admit changed the action trace with levels fixed at 0 (stage moved, endpoint did not). Leak terms f are therefore priced; larger f makes the endpoint CHEAPER, so the deterministic figure is an upper bound on n, not a lower one.

endpoint_ceiling.verdict: At n=12 the required one-way discordance exceeds the ceiling ~2.7x. Ten of twelve games bank nothing and cannot express a difference in either direction, so no 12-cell design at this endpoint can work whatever mediates it.

global_caveat_all_b_inference: EVERY (b) association in this analysis is determined by exactly 2 games (tu93=1, vc33=2). Outlier-dependence is a limitation of the stages declared NON-predictive just as much as of the reverse-causal ones.

answers.cheapest_valid_endpoint: NONE is established. The only surviving mediator CANDIDATE is S7 (held-out accuracy > 0): it responds (12 discordant, p=0.0386) and both banking games sit inside it, the maximum association its group size permits. Its (b) evidence sits AT the n=12 ceiling (floor 0.1515) rather than having been refuted. IF S7 mediates, banked levels costs 34 cells vs the refusal's 68 -- but whether it mediates cannot be decided by more cells at n=12; it needs a corpus with more bankable games (>= ~36 games at the observed 1-in-6 banking rate).
answers.where_the_chain_breaks: Not localizable on this corpus. The largest observed attrition is DYNAMICS -> GOAL (9 -> 4 rounds; 8 of 10 in the sibling corpus), and no induce-side intervention touches the goal predicate. But whether that is a goal-induction defect or a downstream symptom of wrong dynamics is explicitly UNDECIDED by the available data.
answers.correct_engines_per_gpu_hour: Usable engines per GPU-hour is a REAL gain: 2.60x, Poisson p=0.0055 CI[1.25,5.62], paired sign p=0.0025, game-cluster bootstrap CI[2.13,6.75] excluding 1. Correct engines per GPU-hour is NOT: 1.79x p=0.3952, and non-vacuous 1.54x p=0.7201 with identical counts 4 vs 4 -- the entire ratio there is the denominator. Deciding it needs ~7.4x more GPU-hours (266 attempts/arm), ~22x for non-vacuous (793/arm).
answers.submission_status: Banked levels remain 3/3 and the submission gate is UNMET. Nothing was submitted; no scored or online game was played.

licenses: refusing to spend GPU-hours on a 12-cell banked-levels grid for this intervention
reporting usable-engines-per-GPU-hour as a real, thrice-confirmed cost win
treating the goal gate as the largest observed attrition point
does_NOT_license: claiming any stage was shown NOT to predict banked levels -- most were undecidable
claiming the trust gate is refuted as a lever (force-admit never ran on vc33)
claiming correctness predicts levels negatively -- direction is unestablished
attributing the bottleneck to goal induction rather than to weak dynamics

b_prediction_fisher_tests_with_floors.principle: Every (b) row carries min_reachable_p because a test whose floor exceeds alpha cannot reject; reporting such a test as a null is a category error that manufactures a finding out of a design limit.
b_prediction_fisher_tests_with_floors.satisfied_by: exhaustive enumeration of all 2x2 tables consistent with the margins

endpoint_movability.principle: A nonzero endpoint counter is not a positive control; only a manipulation that MOVES the endpoint demonstrates it can be measured at all.
endpoint_movability.satisfied_by: three independent manipulations recomputed from committed cells

required_n.principle: Priced with the refusal's exact model so the figures are comparable to the decision they are meant to revisit, not to a different power model.
required_n.satisfied_by: replication of the refusal's published 68/16 as a scale check

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal-prefixed so the conductor reconciler classifies it as a completed determination rather than retrying it.
